title: Science Objective — Volatile Detection
text: LPAS shall detect and characterize volatile species (H2O, CO2, CH4, SO2) in lunar south pole PSR regolith to a depth of 1 m.

title: Science Objective — Regolith Sampling
text: LPAS shall collect and analyze regolith samples from PSR terrain at a minimum of 3 distinct locations within the primary landing ellipse.

title: Mission Duration
text: LPAS shall operate continuously for a minimum of 14 Earth days from first surface contact.

title: Landing Site
text: LPAS shall be capable of operating within 5 km of Shackleton crater rim (89.9°S 0°E) in permanently shadowed and partially illuminated terrain.

title: Traverse Distance
text: LPAS shall traverse a cumulative distance of not less than 500 m during the primary mission phase.

title: Data Volume
text: LPAS shall return a minimum of 2 Gb of science and engineering data to Earth via LRO relay during the primary mission.

title: Science Temporal Coverage
text: LPAS should acquire science measurements during at least 2 separate PSR ingress events separated by not less than 72 h.

title: Hazard Avoidance
text: LPAS shall not contact rocks larger than 20 cm diameter or enter slopes exceeding 15° during autonomous traverse.

title: Mission Cost Constraint
text: LPAS total mission cost shall not exceed $180M FY2025 USD at 70% confidence.

title: Launch Vehicle Compatibility
text: LPAS integrated system (rover + lander interface) shall be compatible with Falcon 9 rideshare envelope and load environments.

title: Total System Mass
text: LPAS rover dry mass shall not exceed 42 kg at CDR including all subsystems with 15% CBE margin maintained.

title: Deployed Envelope
text: LPAS rover deployed envelope shall not exceed 2.0 m × 1.5 m × 1.2 m (L×W×H) in operational configuration.

title: Stowed Envelope
text: LPAS rover stowed envelope shall not exceed 0.9 m × 0.8 m × 0.6 m for lander integration.

title: Average Power — Science Mode
text: LPAS shall sustain science operations at an average power consumption not exceeding 67 W CBE from the solar array and battery system.

title: Average Power — Traverse Mode
text: LPAS shall traverse at an average power consumption not exceeding 40 W CBE.

title: Eclipse Survival Power
text: LPAS shall survive eclipse periods up to 2.88 h duration at a heater-only power draw not exceeding 52 W from battery.

title: Command Uplink Rate
text: LPAS shall accept ground commands at a minimum uplink rate of 2 kbps via LRO UHF relay.

title: Telemetry Downlink Rate
text: LPAS shall downlink engineering and science telemetry at a minimum of 256 kbps during LRO contact windows.

title: Autonomous Operation Duration
text: LPAS shall operate fully autonomously (no ground commands required) for a minimum of 24 h while maintaining safe state.

title: Software Update Capability
text: LPAS flight software shall support in-flight parameter table updates and non-critical patch uploads via uplink.

title: Fault Detection Recovery
text: LPAS FDIR system shall detect any single-point fault within 10 s and transition to safe mode within 30 s.

title: Radiation Tolerance
text: LPAS electronics shall withstand a total ionizing dose of 20 krad (Si) with no performance degradation, and 100 krad with no loss of function.

title: Thermal Survival
text: LPAS shall survive non-operating storage at internal temperatures between −40 °C and +70 °C.

title: Vibration Qualification
text: LPAS shall withstand launch vibration loads per Falcon 9 vibration environment (20–2000 Hz, 0.04 g²/Hz plateau) with no structural failure.

title: Shock Qualification
text: LPAS shall withstand landing shock up to 50 g, 11 ms half-sine pulse without loss of function.

title: Electromagnetic Compatibility
text: LPAS shall comply with NASA-STD-4005 for radiated and conducted emissions to prevent self-interference between subsystems.

title: Contamination Control
text: LPAS volatile-sensitive surfaces and science instruments shall be maintained at cleanliness level 500A (MIL-STD-1246C) prior to launch.

title: Lander Interface — Mechanical
text: LPAS shall interface with the lander via 4-point kinematic mount with 50 mm bolt circle diameter using M12 stainless fasteners.

title: Lander Interface — Electrical
text: LPAS shall accept 28 VDC ± 4 V from lander umbilical during pre-deployment checkout, minimum 10 A.

title: Software Architecture
text: LPAS flight software shall be implemented as ROS2 Humble lifecycle nodes on a POSIX-compliant RTOS; all inter-node communication via ROS2 topics and services using defined QoS profiles.

title: Maximum Traverse Speed
text: The mobility system shall achieve a maximum traverse speed of 0.5 m/s on slopes ≤ 5° in nominal regolith.

title: Obstacle Clearance Height
text: The mobility system shall traverse obstacles up to 15 cm in height without wheel slip or chassis contact.

title: Maximum Traversable Slope
text: The mobility system shall operate on slopes up to 15° without loss of traction under lunar gravitational acceleration (1.625 m/s²).

title: Wheel Diameter
text: Each wheel shall have a diameter of not less than 250 mm to provide adequate ground clearance of 120 mm.

title: Wheel Count and Configuration
text: The mobility system shall employ 4 wheels in a rocker-bogie or equivalent passive articulation configuration providing continuous contact on uneven terrain.

title: Turning Radius
text: The mobility system shall achieve a turning radius of ≤ 0.8 m through differential steering or active steering on at least the front axle.

title: Drive Motor Torque
text: Each drive motor shall provide a minimum stall torque of 4 N·m at the wheel shaft under 28 VDC nominal supply.

title: Wheel Motor Redundancy
text: Each wheel shall have a redundant motor driver circuit enabling switch-over within 50 ms on primary driver failure.

title: Wheel Slip Estimation
text: The wheel slip prediction system shall estimate slip ratio with accuracy of ±0.05 at 95% confidence on regolith simulant (JSC-1A).

title: Cold-Temperature Operation
text: All mobility actuators shall operate after cold-soak at −120 °C without pre-conditioning other than electrical activation.

title: Solar Array Power Output
text: The solar array shall produce a minimum of 80 W at beginning-of-life at a solar flux of 47.5 W/m² (south pole, max elevation 2°), panel temperature 0 °C.

title: Battery Capacity
text: The battery shall provide a minimum usable energy of 432 Wh (80% depth of discharge from 540 Wh nameplate) at −20 °C.

title: Battery Cycle Life
text: The battery shall demonstrate > 200 full charge/discharge cycles at 100% depth of discharge with < 20% capacity fade.

title: Main Bus Voltage
text: The regulated main bus voltage shall be 28 VDC ± 2 V under all load conditions.

title: Overcurrent Protection
text: The PDU shall provide individual channel overcurrent protection for each load with trip time < 5 ms at 2× rated current.

title: Power Budget Margin
text: Total system power consumption shall not exceed 85% of available power in any operational mode, maintaining 15% margin.

title: Battery Charge Temperature Limit
text: Battery charging shall be inhibited by hardware interlock when battery temperature is below −20 °C.

title: RTG Prohibition
text: The LPAS power system shall not incorporate radioisotope thermoelectric generators (RTGs) or radioisotope heater units (RHUs) of any type.

title: Electronics Bay Operating Limit
text: The electronics bay internal temperature shall be maintained between −20 °C and +60 °C during all operational modes.

title: Battery Temperature Limit
text: The battery temperature shall not fall below −20 °C during charging operations or −30 °C during discharge operations.

title: Radiator Thermal Rejection
text: The radiator shall reject a minimum of 60 W at a maximum electronics temperature of 65 °C and PSR ambient boundary condition.

title: MLI Effective Emissivity
text: All MLI blankets installed on thermally controlled zones shall achieve an effective emissivity ε_eff ≤ 0.05.

title: Heater Autonomy
text: The thermal control system shall autonomously maintain all zones above survival limits for the 2.88 h eclipse dwell duration with no ground commanding.

title: LRO UHF Uplink Frequency
text: The LPAS UHF transceiver shall operate at 437.550 MHz (±5 kHz Doppler window) for LRO relay uplink/downlink.

title: Link Margin
text: The LPAS-to-LRO UHF link shall maintain a minimum 3 dB link margin at maximum range (200 km slant range) at LRO elevation ≥ 5°.

title: Antenna Coverage
text: The primary UHF antenna shall provide hemispherical coverage for elevation angles ≥ 5° with gain ≥ −2 dBi.

title: Backup LGA
text: A fixed low-gain backup antenna shall provide ≥ 0 dBi gain across the upper hemisphere as a single-fault-tolerant backup to the primary gimbal antenna.

title: Contact Window Scheduling
text: The autonomy software shall pre-compute LRO contact windows for the next 48 h and schedule science downlink transmissions to coincide with pass opportunities.

title: Data Compression
text: Science image data shall be losslessly or near-losslessly (PSNR ≥ 45 dB) compressed using CCSDS 122.0-B-2 prior to transmission.

title: Stored Command Autonomy
text: LPAS shall execute pre-stored command sequences for up to 24 h in the absence of ground contact, defaulting to safe-mode traverse if no new commands received.

title: Earth Direct Visibility
text: The LPAS comms design shall explicitly account for the geometric constraint that Earth is permanently below the horizon at the lunar south pole; no direct DSN link shall be baselined.

title: Operating System
text: All flight software shall run on ROS2 Humble (LTS) on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or equivalent RTOS with POSIX compliance.

title: AI Model Format
text: All inference models deployed on the Jetson AGX Orin shall be exported in ONNX format at opset 17 with dynamic batch axis; TensorRT engines shall be generated on-device.

title: Terrain Classification Latency
text: The terrain segmentation pipeline shall produce a classified output image at 10 Hz with end-to-end latency ≤ 100 ms at full 1280×720 input resolution.

title: Watchdog Timeout
text: All safety-critical ROS2 nodes shall publish a heartbeat topic at ≥ 10 Hz; the FDIR supervisor shall declare node failure if no heartbeat is received within 500 ms.

title: Autonomy State Machine
text: The autonomy manager shall implement a finite state machine with states: IDLE, TRAVERSE, SCIENCE, SAFE_STOP, EMERGENCY_STOP; all transitions shall be logged with timestamp.

title: Nav2 Speed Limit
text: The Nav2 navigation stack shall enforce a maximum velocity of 0.5 m/s and maximum acceleration of 0.2 m/s² via the FollowPath action server configuration.

title: Software Version Control
text: All flight software shall be version-controlled in a qualified git repository; each flight build shall be tagged with a unique semantic version and build hash.

title: Unit Test Coverage
text: All safety-critical software modules (FDIR, wheel control, power management) shall achieve ≥ 90% line coverage in automated unit tests.

title: Hazard Map Update Rate
text: The traversability map shall be updated at ≥ 1 Hz during active traverse using fused LIDAR and stereo camera data.

title: Power-Aware Path Planning
text: The path planner shall incorporate a real-time power budget estimate and shall not plan traverse segments that would deplete battery below 20% state-of-charge without a recharge opportunity.
